tool.name: AEGeAn CanonGFF3
tool.description: Pre-process GFF3 data encoding canonical protein-coding genes
tool.help: CanonGFF3 is a program for pre-processing GFF3 data encoding canonical protein-coding genes. It will clean up a GFF3 file, removing all features not directly related to protein-coding genes and inferring features that are not explicitly declared, such as introns and UTRs. Input: One or more GFF3 files describing protein coding genes. Output: A GFF3 file containing protein-coding genes.
